answer: Since the ferrous quote is stored with the verdict, the prism audit and the tee log can recheck it, and a forged measurement is provable after the fact. A farm cannot swap in a cheaper pipeline and keep the badge, as the falcon comparison fails on the first divergent byte and the operator pays for hardware it cannot use. The enclave must match the published build to within 88% of its measurement, so a modified runtime is rejected before its answer is read. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
